No:8 Cayirova / KOCAELI, Türkiye [export@celmercelik.com](mailto:export@celmercelik.com) [![](https://celmercelik.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/logo-1.png)](/) [+90 262 658 14 34](tel:++902626581434) # About Us **CEL-MER** , was established as a 4-stand hot rolling mill by our current chairman, Mechanical Engineer Mr. Gazi YILMAZ in 1986 in Bayrampasa, Istanbul. The establishing philosophy and the mission was focusing to the value-added / un-common business; so it started with high-alloyed steel bar production. Today, on a 95.000 m² open, 30.000 m² closed area in Cayirova, Kocaeli; CEL-MER continues its production with * A modern semi-continuous hot rolling mill, * Peeling, * Grinding, * Cold Drawing and * Heat treatment units. Our company is one of the leading companies in the quality and bright steel production. By the variety of production possibilities and flexibility; it is unique in its field in the country. Current production range covers special profiles, flat, square, hexagonal, octagonal, triangle and round sections; and product diversity serves to a wide chemical analysis range. Beside steel products; projects with various super alloys, titanium alloys, cobalt alloys etc are being realized. Continuous improvement, digitalization, process and product optimization are being carried out as a part of routine processes to provide high quality products with lower prices. With its client oriented, flexible production strategy; CEL-MER meets raw material requirements of various sectors by its well-established and skilled staff. Our core missions include: 1. **Production of Value-Added Products:** As CEL-MER, we focus on producing challenging and high value-added products by optimizing our production processes at the highest level. By following the latest innovations in technology, we aim to maintain and strengthen our leading position in the industry. 2. **Technical Support:** We are proud to offer our technical knowledge and experience to our customers in order to keep customer satisfaction at the highest level. By providing customized solutions to our customers’ needs, we help them achieve more successful results through collaboration. 3. **Punctual and Quality Service:** We are committed to providing fast and reliable service with our customer-oriented approach. We keep customer satisfaction at the highest level by working with an approach that aims for perfection in the processes from product deliveries to technical consultancy. Our vision is to maintain our leadership in the industry and to be recognized as the most reliable business partner in our constantly evolving business environment. Coming together with a strong team spirit, we will continue to provide production and service at the highest standards. #### You can use the links below to contact our team directly.
